Design, develop, test, and maintain secure, scalable, and highly available full stack applications.

Lead technical estimation, sprint planning, dependency management, risk resolution, and delivery governance.

Use approved AI-assisted development tools to improve delivery productivity, documentation, testing, and code quality.

Assess emerging engineering tools and recommend practical adoption patterns aligned with enterprise standards.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Software engineering experience, and proven experience delivering full stack applications.
Proven delivery of enterprise-scale, high-availability, or mission-critical digital platforms.
Hands-on experience building cloud-native and microservices-based solutions.
Experience leading technical delivery, mentoring engineers, and working in Agile environments.
Strong problem-solving, stakeholder communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

jobs.description:
Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region.




Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA.




Role Summary




We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team behind the surfaces that bring millions of people to Property Finder every month — search, property and location content, and the platforms that serve them across multiple countries and languages.

This is high-traffic, consumer-facing, and unusually unforgiving: page latency, cache behaviour, and data correctness are not just engineering quality metrics here, they directly move organic acquisition and revenue. You'll work close to the numbers and see the impact of your decisions in production within days.

It's a hands-on senior role. You'll design and own services end to end, influence architecture beyond your squad, and raise the bar for the engineers around you.




Key Responsibilities




Design, build, and operate the backend services powering our highest-traffic consumer surfaces.
Own your work end to end: design, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and the follow-up iteration based on what production actually tells you.
Build new services and features in TypeScript (Node.js), and maintain and evolve our existing Go services.
Work at the edges of the system — caching, CDN behaviour, content delivery, and rendering paths — where small changes have outsized effects on cost and performance.
Build for multiple countries and languages from day one: content, localisation, and market-specific behaviour are the default, not an afterthought.
Partner with product, SEO, data, and web/mobile engineers to turn requirements into systems that stay maintainable after the first release.
Drive operational excellence: monitoring, alerting, incident response, and continuous improvement of reliability, latency, and infrastructure cost.
Mentor engineers, review designs and PRs properly, and shape our backend standards.




Desired Qualifications




Must have 5+ years of backend engineering, with significant time on high-traffic, consumer-facing systems.
Strong TypeScript (Node.js) — the primary language for all new work.
Go, or a track record that says you'll pick it up fast. Our existing production services are in Go and you'll own them alongside new development.
Experience designing and operating services in a distributed environment: API design, service boundaries, versioning, and inter-service communication — plus the judgement to know when not to split something.
Hands-on with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL), caching (Redis), and search (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch), including schema design, indexing, and query performance tuning under real load.
Production experience on AWS with containerised workloads, and genuine fluency in observability: metrics, structured logging, distributed tracing, SLOs, and being on the hook when something breaks.




Additional Capabilities




Event-driven and asynchronous processing (Kafka, SQS, or similar).
Edge computing and CDN-level logic (Lambda@Edge, CloudFront), and multi-region considerations.

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.

Le contexte

La squad Productivity est au cœur de la transformation produit autour de la gestion des affaires contentieuses de bout en bout.

Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi, au-delà du seul gain de productivité, en allant vers l'accompagnement de la réflexion et de l'argumentation juridique, à travers plusieurs langues.

Aujourd’hui, elle est responsable de toute la chaîne de valeur :


Analyse de documents
Rédaction automatisée des conclusions et documents juridiques
Réflexion stratégique sur l’argumentation


C’est le cœur de notre IA appliquée au raisonnement juridique : travail avancé sur les modèles LLM, le machine learning et la structuration de documents complexes.1.

Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github !

A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :)

Les missions 🛠
